description: Victor 933's damaged transmission (owner request, 2026-10-13; docs/victor933-interference.md). The owner chose the 11 phrases and their kinds; the times were aligned on the CE es-MX recording (source timeline, seconds).

alignment.method: Windows es-ES speech recognizer (System.Speech dictation) word timings, utterance 2 anchored at +16.15 s on the recording's silences (20.25 s, 23.09 s); every edge snapped to the nearest energy valley (+-50 ms, 10 ms frames); fragment edges placed at syllable/closure valleys.
uncertain: 1 'Aquí': the recording opens with 0.15 s of silence; 'a' 0.15-0.25 s, closure, 'quí' to about 0.40 s (joins 'la' with no pause).
5 '…til aliení…': the recognizer heard 'oscilaría en escena'; the edges are the 't' closure of 'hostil' (9.51 s) and the 'g' of 'alienígena' (10.08 s).
10 '…víen … transmis…': 'en-' of 'envíen' has no valley before 'ví'; the end leaves '-ión' audible (22.92 s).

kinds.partial: Low but understandable: speech ducked, static underneath.
kinds.masked: Not understandable: speech muted, replaced by MCC static.
